clearer_why: B fans the Agent's five outgoing edges out to a single row of labels (prompt, search, execute, draw, events) right above their targets, so each arrow is easy to match. A runs four parallel lines plus a dashed one down the right side as a bundle, and its 'prompt' and 'search' labels sit ambiguously near the Agent, with 'search' next to the orange line that actually goes to Model API.
looks_why: A has crisper, bolder type and tidy uppercase group headers, but it stretches into a tall single column with a long bundle of parallel wires, a mid-word hyphen in 'diagonaldi-agrams' and an odd 'box = step' footer. B's plainer Mermaid-style boxes form a more balanced layout, with tools side by side and cylinders for the stores.
weak_A: bundle of parallel lines from Agent with ambiguous labels
weak_B: plain default styling and small type; persist line crosses svg edge
